# `hermes_audit` Component Index

> Filtered copy for this plugin: it lists only the modules vendored here (`architecture_gate`, `componentize_evidence`, `componentize_survey`, `project_kit`, `tool_schema_cost`). The upstream index lists more modules, which are not shipped.

Index format: one line per reusable check component:
`<module>.<function>(<signature>)` — what it checks — return dict shape.
Read this index before writing any check; update the relevant line in the same commit when adding or changing a component.
Standalone plugins that vendor a component module must start the copy with exactly `# vendored from hermes_audit/<module>.py, do not edit` (a `components/` library uses `# vendored from components/<module>.py, do not edit`); the gate's vendored role also accepts two older exact forms for existing copies (`_VENDORED_HEADER_FORMS` in `architecture_gate.py`).

- `tool_schema_cost.parse_plugin_manifest(text)` — reads name/provides_tools in a narrow YAML subset, unsupported forms unknown — returns `{ok,status,error,findings,known,name,provides_tools}`.
- `tool_schema_cost.capture_plugin(*, plugin_dir, python, env, budget_tokens=2000, timeout=60, max_output=4194304, run=_run)` — records trusted plugin declared schemas in an isolated child with explicit context and Hermes positional/keyword tool registration (name, toolset, schema, handler); runners inject bounded execution (max_output UTF-8 bytes); cumulative retained schema bytes latch overflow before further retention, with a final exact protocol-size cap — returns `{ok,status,error,findings,path,name,capture,reason,tokens,budget_tokens,tools,groups,per_tool?}`.
- `tool_schema_cost.find_repeated_subschemas(tools, *, min_chars=500, max_nodes=50000, max_depth=64, max_examples=5)` — finds largest-first nonoverlapping occurrence-level duplication candidates using per-tool ancestor path sets, preflight traversal limits, and iterative bottom-up typed Merkle fingerprints with exact canonical JSON character lengths and legacy SHA-256 tie ordering — returns `{ok,status,error,findings,groups,partial}`.
- `tool_schema_cost.estimate_tool_tokens(tools)` — estimates declared schema major-field characters using Hermes chars/4, rounding totals once — returns `{ok,status,error,findings,chars,tokens,tools}`.

- `architecture_gate.audit_module(path, *, source, role, index_text=None, vendor_source=None)` — Purpose: Static architecture gate: audits one Python module source against the repository Architecture Standard by role (component, runner, runner_module, vendored, one_off) and returns the findings envelope; owns the vendored-copy rule: the first line must be one of four exact header forms naming the module, and the body must equal the source. — returns `{ok,status,error,findings,role,module,coverage}`.
- `componentize_survey.survey_sources(sources)` — Purpose: inventory Python source without execution and propose review-only reusable component splits — returns `{schema,ok,status,error,findings,files,proposed_splits}` with schema `componentize.survey/1`.
- `componentize_evidence.validate_manifest(manifest)` — Purpose: validate componentize spec.json manifests (schema v1/v2; v2 component files require substantive purpose), including optional ordered hermes_plugins records (absolute interpreter, unique paths, non-secret string env, positive budget/timeout) — returns `{ok,status,error,findings,schema_version,kind,name}`.
- `componentize_evidence.render_component_index_line(entry, *, public_api, returns)` — Purpose: render a COMPONENTS.md line including a component file's purpose when supplied, without writing files — returns `str`.
- `componentize_evidence.canonical_sha256(value)` — pure helper (not an envelope) computing SHA-256 hex digest of canonical JSON (`sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False`) — returns `str`.
- `componentize_evidence.compare_capture(baseline, actual, *, compare)` — compares captured `{stdout,stderr,rc}` dicts across selected streams (`stdout`, `stderr`, `rc`) — returns `{ok,status,error,findings,matched,streams}`.
- `componentize_evidence.evidence_digest(*, name, schema_version, manifest_sha, manifest_gen, baseline_gen, baseline_shas, file_hashes, checker_digest, runtime, attestations_sha, amend_log_sha, check_result_sha, check_status)` — pure helper (not an envelope) computing canonical SHA-256 digest over the 13 receipt evidence fields — returns `str`.
- `componentize_evidence.verify_receipt(receipt, *, current)` — verifies a componentize receipt (schema v1, passing status, `evidence_digest` integrity, and staleness against `current`) — returns `{ok,status,error,findings,name,stale}`.

- `project_kit.validate_kit(kit)` — checks a project-kit dict against schema v1 (unknown keys, unsafe paths, undeclared variables, AGENTS.md block size) — returns `{ok,status,error,findings}`.
- `project_kit.resolve_variables(kit, root, variables=None)` — kit defaults plus overrides, `project` from the folder name — returns `(values|None, error|None)`.
- `project_kit.block_markers(kit_id, version)` — the begin/end marker lines of a kit's managed AGENTS.md block — returns `(begin, end)`.
- `project_kit.render_agents_block(kit, values)` — managed AGENTS.md block (purpose, layout, rules) for a validated kit — returns `str`.
- `project_kit.merge_block(existing, block, kit_id)` — adds or refreshes one kit's block, leaving all other text and other kits' blocks untouched — returns `(text, "created"|"appended"|"updated"|"current"|"malformed")`.
- `project_kit.declared_dirs(kit, values)` — kit folders in the shape a file-placement tool needs — returns `list[{dir,summary,why}]`.
- `project_kit.placement_rules(kit, values)` — extension-based file-placement rules declared by a kit, with variables filled — returns `list[{kind,match_ext,dest_dir,lfs,reason}]`.
- `project_kit.kit_tree(kit, values)` — sorted relative paths a kit creates (folders with trailing `/`, declared files, `AGENTS.md`, and `.gitignore`/`.gitattributes` when present) — returns `list[str]`.
- `project_kit.inspect_kit(kit, root, *, variables=None, forbidden=(), hermes_homes=())` — read-only report of which kit pieces exist under root; always refuses system folders, `forbidden` refuses each entry and its ancestors, `hermes_homes` refuses each entry and everything inside it (symlinks resolved) — returns `{ok,status,error,findings,root,kit,items,declared_dirs,placement_rules}`.
- `project_kit.apply_kit(kit, root, *, variables=None, forbidden=(), hermes_homes=())` — creates missing folders/files, one managed AGENTS.md block and missing ignore/LFS lines; never overwrites, refuses symlinks; always refuses system folders, `forbidden` refuses each entry and its ancestors, `hermes_homes` refuses each entry and everything inside it (symlinks resolved) — returns `{ok,status,error,findings,root,kit,items,declared_dirs,placement_rules}`.
- `project_kit.forbidden_roots(home, hermes_home=None)` — Purpose: Validate declarative project kits and apply them to a dedicated project folder, refusing unsafe target folders, without overwriting files. — pure helper (not an envelope): keyword arguments for `apply_kit`/`inspect_kit` that refuse the home, its ancestors and everything inside its Hermes homes; callers expand `~` and relative values first — returns `{forbidden,hermes_homes}`.
